# Kadivar & Associates

Kadivar & Associates is an elite Chartered Accountancy firm based in Rajkot, Gujarat, India, led by Founder & Managing Partner CA Irfan Kadivar.

## Core Services
- Tax Planning & Compliance
- Statutory Audit
- GST & Indirect Taxes
- Corporate Finance
- Management Consultancy
- Investment & Wealth

## Philosophy
We operate as a strategic growth partner, integrating into daily operations to architect tax-efficient structures and mitigate risk before compliance deadlines approach.
